l2_generator_use_revision.method: Generator-declared use/ignore and source-specific function with deterministic full-resource/full-response audit surfaces; small human qualification second. Unqualified automated judges cannot create labels.
rules: MP preference can be used behaviorally without explicit reference.
If selected evidence is redundant or irrelevant, ignoring it is correct.
A use decision binds one authorized resource label and one source-specific function.
The runtime attaches the full selected-resource and response surfaces; copied snippets are not a scientific outcome.
A self-declaration is not gold until a small stratified human check confirms the declared function.

structured_trace_v2.interpretation: Copied excerpt failures are treated as interface bookkeeping, not failed resource use; the formal trace uses runtime-attached full surfaces.

minimum_human_qualification.selection: two stable-hash use declarations per component plus every ignore declaration
minimum_human_qualification.failure_action: Repair only generator prompt/trace; do not change PM labels or expand routing data.
